scope: Modular PMA, software module first: device software functions, cybersecurity, risk management, usability interface, SOUP/OTS; Documentation Level = Enhanced
status: Research draft for profile construction. Not a regulatory checklist; guidance recommendations are nonbinding except where statute/regulation is cited. Clause citations are to PDFs opened in this pass (see README.md).

conventions.id_scheme: L1-NN bins; L2-NN.MM sub-elements (NN = parent L1); parameters are L3 and are addressed as <L2 id>.<parameter name>.
conventions.clauses: {src: register id, loc: clause/section}. Register ids resolve in STANDARDS-REGISTER.md (STD-*, AUTH-*, REF-*).
conventions.required_enhanced: true = parameter should be captured for every entity at Enhanced level; false = conditional or when available.
conventions.check: What the recomposition compares the captured value against. Anchors (A.*) are defined below and resolved once per case.

check_type.mechanical: Deterministic comparison on ids, dates, versions, enums or set membership.
check_type.judgment: Requires reviewer/specialist reasoning; recomposition can only flag candidates.

conventions.l1_document_parameters: Captured once per source document feeding the L1; every L2 entity cites its document_id.
conventions.importance: 1 supporting detail, 2 material review question, 3 decision-critical (review/SCORING.md semantics) - tailored here for a PMA software module at Enhanced level.

anchors.A.proposed_version: Software version string proposed for marketing (final release version; FDA-SW VI.B 'Software Specifics', VI.I last entry). Source: L2-03.01.
anchors.A.release_build_id: Unique build identifier of the release candidate (build number, commit hash or image digest). Source: L2-03.02.
anchors.A.configuration_set: Set of configuration items and versions comprising the software system configuration incl. OS, runtime, SOUP, models/rules/reference data (IEC 62304 8.1.3). Source: L2-03.03.
anchors.A.code_freeze_date: Date the release-candidate baseline was frozen (last approved change request implemented). Source: L2-03.04.
anchors.A.release_date: Date of software release for utilization at system level (IEC 62304 5.8). Source: L2-03.04.
anchors.A.test_window: Declared start and end dates of formal verification/validation execution against the release candidate. Source: L2-09.08 (test summary).
anchors.A.module_submission_date: Date of the modular PMA software module (or amendment) submission. Source: L2-00.02.
anchors.A.labeled_version: Version identifier shown in labeling, IFU and on-screen identification. Source: L2-29.01.
anchors.A.sbom_build: Build/version the SBOM states it describes. Source: L2-16.01.
anchors.A.risk_file_version: Version and date of the risk management file/report relied on. Source: L2-04.08.
anchors.A.threat_model_version: Version, date and configuration covered by the threat model. Source: L2-14.01.
anchors.A.supported_platforms: Hardware, OS, browser/cloud and peripheral platforms claimed as supported. Source: L2-02.03.
anchors.A.device_support_end: Manufacturer-stated end of support / end of life for the device software. Source: L2-25.07 / L2-24.10.
anchors.A.prior_authorized_version: Previously approved/cleared software version and submission number, if any (FDA-SW VI.I). Source: L2-10.03.

l2.importance_reason: Frames representativeness of HF validation and URRA.

parameters.name: user_groups
parameters.check: must equal intended_users in L2-02.01; each distinct group needs representation in summative test (62366-1 5.7.3 e))

parameters.name: use_environments
parameters.check: summative environment must represent these

parameters.name: training_provided
parameters.check: summative training must correspond to real-world training (FDA-HFC26 V Section 8)

l2.currency_rule: reviewer judgment.

l2.title: UI characteristics related to safety, known use problems
l2.expectation: UI characteristics that could relate to safety and potential use errors identified; known use problems of prior/similar devices summarized.
l2.importance_reason: Inputs to URRA.

parameters.name: known_use_problems
parameters.check: explicit 'none known' statement acceptable (FDA-HFC26 V Section 4)

parameters.name: sources_searched
parameters.check: e.g. MAUDE, recalls

l2.currency_rule: reviewer judgment.

l2.title: Use-related risk analysis (URRA) and critical tasks
l2.expectation: All user tasks with possible use errors, hazardous situations, harms, severity, critical-task flag, risk controls and validation method; severity scale referenced.
l2.importance_reason: Critical tasks drive HF category and validation scope.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.check: must trace to RMF hazards (L2-04.03) and HF validation scenarios (L2-27.08) (FDA-HFC26 Table 2 fn 33)

parameters.name: task_type
parameters.check: knowledge|performance

parameters.name: hazardous_situation_id
parameters.check: must exist in L2-04.03

parameters.name: severity
parameters.check: scale must equal RMF severity scale (L2-04.01)

parameters.name: critical_task
parameters.check: true if serious harm possible incl. compromised medical care (FDA-HFC26 III definition)

parameters.name: risk_control_ids
parameters.check: must exist in L2-04.05 / UI spec (L2-27.05)

parameters.name: effectiveness_validation_method
parameters.check: must point to summative scenario or rationale

parameters.name: urra_version_date
parameters.check: should be same baseline as risk file A.risk_file_version

l2.currency_rule: FDA-HFC26 V Section 6: URRA is a living document updated through design.

l2.title: HF Submission Category and summative scenario selection
l2.expectation: Category 1/2/3 determined with rationale through decision points; selection scheme for summative scenarios documented.
l2.importance_reason: Determines whether HF validation data must be in the submission.

parameters.name: hf_submission_category
parameters.check: 1|2|3; new device with critical tasks and no robust rationale => 3

parameters.name: decision_point_answers
parameters.check: A-D answers must be consistent with URRA critical_task flags

parameters.name: rationale_in_lieu_of_validation
parameters.check: Category 2 via D=No requires objective evidence (FDA-HFC26 IV)

parameters.name: summative_selection_scheme
parameters.check: IEC 62366-1 5.5: all, severity-based subset, or other with rationale

l2.currency_rule: FDA-HFC26 implementation: submissions received before Aug 1 2026 not expected to follow new content; check receipt date vs A.module_submission_date.

l2.title: User interface specification and description
l2.expectation: Testable UI requirements incl. those implementing risk controls; whether accompanying documentation/training required; UI description with images and operational sequence.
l2.importance_reason: Links UI risk controls to SRS and test.

parameters.name: ui_requirement_ids
parameters.check: each must exist in SRS (L2-05.02) with category user interaction

parameters.name: ui_version_described
parameters.check: screens shown must match A.proposed_version UI

l2.currency_rule: reviewer judgment.

l2.title: UI evaluation plan (formative and summative)
l2.expectation: Plan specifies methods, UI parts, criteria for information for safety, documentation/training availability, participant representativeness, environment and correct-use definitions.
l2.importance_reason: Protocol quality determines validity of summative results.

parameters.name: plan_approval_date
parameters.check: must precede summative execution start

parameters.name: correct_use_definitions
parameters.check: one per hazard-related use scenario (5.7.3 e))

l2.currency_rule: IEC 62366-1 5.7.3 Note 4: summative plan usually finalized after formative evaluation.

l2.title: Formative evaluations and resulting design changes
l2.expectation: Formative methods, key results, UI modifications and findings informing the validation protocol.
l2.importance_reason: Context for summative design; not decisive alone.

parameters.name: design_changes_made
parameters.check: changes must appear in L2-10.02

l2.currency_rule: reviewer judgment.

l2.title: Summative / human factors validation on final design
l2.expectation: Summative evaluation of each selected scenario on the final or production-equivalent UI, with participants, environment, training, tasks, success definitions, observed use errors/close calls, root-cause analysis.
l2.importance_reason: Effectiveness verification for use-related risk controls; Category 3 core evidence.

parameters.name: ui_software_version_tested
parameters.check: must equal A.proposed_version UI or production-equivalent with technical rationale (62366-1 5.9)

parameters.name: labeling_version_used
parameters.check: IFU/labels used must equal final labeling (FDA-HF16 8.1.3)

parameters.name: test_dates
parameters.check: must be after UI freeze and before A.module_submission_date

parameters.name: participants_by_group
parameters.check: must cover each user group in L2-27.01

parameters.name: critical_tasks_tested
parameters.check: must include all critical tasks from L2-27.03 (or rationale)

parameters.name: use_errors_close_calls_difficulties
parameters.check: each with root cause when leading to hazardous situation (62366-1 5.9)

l2.currency_rule: IEC 62366-1 5.9: summative evaluation on the final or production-equivalent user interface; FDA-HF16 8: UI represents final design.

l2.title: Use-related residual risk and further improvement decision
l2.expectation: Use errors leading to hazardous situations analysed; justification where further improvement not practicable; residual risk evaluated per ISO 14971 7.3.

parameters.name: residual_risk_evaluation_ref
parameters.check: must exist in L2-04.06

l2.currency_rule: reviewer judgment.

l2.currency_rule: reviewer judgment.

l2.currency_rule: reviewer judgment.

l2.title: DoC required elements
l2.expectation: Each DoC names applicant, product identification, statement of conformity, standards with options selected, FDA recognition numbers, date/place, signature/name/function, and limitations on validity.

parameters.check: unique per declaration

parameters.name: applicant_name_address

parameters.name: options_selected
parameters.check: required where the standard offers options (FDA-STD IV.A(1) d)

parameters.check: must exist in A.recognition_db_snapshot and correspond to the cited edition

parameters.name: date_of_issue
parameters.check: must be on/before A.module_submission_date and after completion of the testing it relies on

parameters.name: signatory_name_function
parameters.check: FDA-STD IV.A(1) g

parameters.name: limitations_on_validity

l2.title: Recognition status, edition, transition and extent

clauses.loc: IV (footnote 8: specific version and clauses), IV.A(3) b, V (transition periods), VIII (withdrawn standards)
Recognition and Withdrawal guidance (Sep 15 2020; added to library during this run, not opened)

l2.expectation: Cited edition has a current recognition number; if outgoing edition, DoC is within transition; partial recognition exclusions respected.
l2.importance_reason: Edition/extent mismatch is the most mechanical DoC defect.

parameters.name: recognized_edition_db
parameters.check: from register; compare string-normalized with DoC edition

parameters.name: recognition_number_db
parameters.check: must equal DoC recognition number

parameters.name: extent_of_recognition_db
parameters.check: complete|partial; if partial, DoC must not claim unrecognized clauses (e.g. 11073-40101 8.6; HE75 Section 9)

parameters.name: transition_expiry_date
parameters.check: if DoC edition is outgoing, A.module_submission_date must be on/before expiry (e.g. CVSS v3.0 until 2026-12-20; TIR45:2012 until 2028-07-02; ISO 20417:2021 until 2029-07-01)

parameters.name: withdrawn_flag
parameters.check: withdrawn standards cannot support a DoC (FDA-STD VIII)

parameters.name: sis_notes
parameters.check: e.g. SIS notes that conformance may not satisfy 524B; exploitability vs probability note on 5-125/13-131/13-83

l2.currency_rule: Recognition database as of review date (2026-10-01); transition dates per SIS.

l2.title: Conformance scope, clauses claimed and deviations

clauses.loc: IV (DoC = conformity to all requirements; no deviation), IV.A(3) c, IV.B
VI.G (DoC to specific IEC 62304 clauses: Enhanced 5.1, 6, 8; complete DoC not needed)

l2.expectation: Clauses covered are explicit; no deviations from the normative part (else general use); for IEC 62304, Enhanced DoC covers 5.1, 6 and 8.
l2.importance_reason: Clause-level extent is what makes a DoC usable as a substitute for documentation.

parameters.name: clauses_claimed
parameters.check: for STD-62304 under Enhanced: must include 5.1 (all subclauses), 6, 8 (FDA-SW VI.G(2))

parameters.name: clauses_excluded_or_na
parameters.check: each exclusion needs applicability rationale

parameters.name: deviations_declared
parameters.check: any deviation => not a DoC; treat as general use and require 814.20(b)(5)(ii) explanation

parameters.name: safety_class_or_options_assumed
parameters.check: e.g. IEC 62304 software safety class; must be consistent with A.documentation_level rationale (FDA-SW VI.G notes categorization differences)

l2.currency_rule: reviewer judgment.

l2.title: Applicability to the device and to the proposed build/configuration

clauses.loc: IV.A (scope of standard; final finished device; justify tested vs marketed differences), IV.A(3) d

l2.expectation: Standard is applicable to the device; testing/process evidence underlying the DoC relates to the final finished device and proposed software build, or differences are justified.
l2.importance_reason: A DoC based on an earlier build is stale evidence.

parameters.name: device_in_standard_scope
parameters.check: if not in scope or SIS, explanation required (FDA-STD IV.A)

parameters.name: software_version_covered_by_doc
parameters.check: must equal A.proposed_version or differences justified

parameters.name: underlying_evidence_ids
parameters.check: test/process reports relied upon; each must exist in this module

parameters.name: evidence_completion_date
parameters.check: must be before date_of_issue (L2-28.01)

parameters.name: tested_vs_marketed_difference_justification
parameters.check: required when tested article is not final finished device

l2.currency_rule: FDA-STD IV.A: testing on final finished device recommended; justify differences.

parameters.name: lab_report_ids_dates
